name: Stagnation
overview: Scripture warns against spiritual stagnation as seen in Deuteronomy 1:6, where God commands His people to move forward rather than dwell too long in one place. Restoration and renewal are promised in Joel 2:25, highlighting God's power to restore lost time and growth. Believers are called to actively build up one another through wholesome speech (Ephesians 4:29) and faithful fellowship (Hebrews 10:25), fostering continual spiritual progress. Additionally, patience producing maturity (James 1:4) encourages perseverance through trials to avoid complacency and attain completeness in Christ.
